bullets: Reduced community skill levels from five to three by removing the two highest tiers.
Added extra usage time prizes for top spots in each community skill level.
Enabled community feed items to be labeled as hot or rising to show current attention.
Updated desktop workspace validation to accept temporary testing environments that share a single number prefix.
Set the default community profile name for new members to New maker.
Added a tool to convert chosen names into valid lowercase web addresses for community profiles.
Added a flag to account data indicating when a user is still using the default profile name.
Updated internal documentation for lifetime token costs to reference Claude Code API pricing.
Updated mobile setup tracking notes to reflect the new checklist trigger and computer store page actions.
